acceptanceCriteria: Each package moved to the resolved set declares its out-of-package reads so gate-affected-select can bound them, with a test that an undeclared read keeps it unresolved.
The unresolved count and the wall time of a one-file change's gate are measured before and after, with cmd/corvint's split or bound recorded in BUILD-LOG.
body:
The 0.8.1 gate partitions 101 packages under per-package keys and 129 unresolved under the tree key (tests read paths via os.Getwd, `..` or git that the affected-plan index cannot bound). Any tree change reruns all 129; cmd/corvint alone takes about 591 s (V1-0226). The owner asked on 2026-09-24 why Corvint cannot already name only the tests a change needs.

2026-10-01 measured CI investigation: at clean public main adf8358220769b8d6724ad27d27625602b8a7c62, native gate-affected-select -unresolved inventories 159 of 284 root packages. A controlled newline-only edit to internal/behaviorfalsify/receipt_test.go gives Corvint 141 provider packages and selector 171 packages, scope UNKNOWN. The exact PR #416 merge replay selects 245 of 287 packages. These are advisory counts, not proof of safe omission or measured runtime savings. Owner again requested Corvint to test only what needs testing in CI. Current generic pins remain empty, and enabling them serializes the selected suite on shard 0; qualification/execution-profile work is separate. Existing acceptance criteria and authority remain unchanged. Independent read-only review checked counts against actual receipts; evidence /private/tmp/corvint-ci-approval-findings.json and GitHub run 36878582999.

2026-10-01 AFP-V0-023 (PR https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/438, branch claude/ci-affected-selection at 8f7a8ba8 on origin/main 2aec8fec): the project-owned .corvint/test-read-scopes.json declares measured read scopes for 99 root-locating test packages (75 entries), so planner and selector select them through DECLARED_READ_SCOPE instead of the rule (d) floor; an invalid declaration fails closed to the full run. Full CI runs declared packages under the Landlock wrapper .github/testconfine (ABI>=2), so a too-narrow scope fails rather than under-selects. Replay of 16 recent merges: mean 200->166 packages selected (-17.1%), 5023->4543 package-seconds (-9.6%). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-01-declared-test-read-scopes.md; CEM .corvint/changes/6eec96cac12c30d6ccecbeec9659716d72e392c7.cem.json (52/52 supported, dogfood-check PASS, sealed); focused tests pass; one independent review, both should-fix findings fixed. NOT_RUN: hosted confined full CI run (needs admin ci-control-plane approval for .github at the exact head), make gate. cmd/corvint is NOT declared and stays selected through import edges and its own reads; six packages were rejected (fail only confined) and 15 env-limited packages were NOT_RUN, all staying on the floor. Keep open until the hosted confined run passes and the remaining unresolved set is re-measured. Follow-ups V1-0633..V1-0636.

2026-10-01 hosted run of PR438 at 8f7a8ba8 (run 36917489536): all four go-product shards failed. Every confined failure was a nested go build (adapter, fixture or CLI under test) failing 'error obtaining VCS status: exit status 128' because the Landlock ruleset denies .git (intended: git reads are the unbounded class) while Go stamps VCS by default. tools/gate-ledger also failed unconfined: TestGoTestKeysResolvedPackagesPerPackage copies the tool's sources and omitted the new readscopes.go (the earlier 'fails either way' diagnosis was this PR's own defect). The derivation masked the VCS failure: its snapshot had no .git and set GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false. Fix d22fbe14: the wrapper appends -buildvcs=false to GOFLAGS for confined binaries only (testconfine.ConfinedEnv, TestConfinedEnvTurnsOffVCSStamping_AFPV0023); .git stays denied; the fixture copies readscopes.go. Re-verified in a real clone with .git, GOFLAGS empty, GOPROXY=off and the revised wrapper (golang:1.27.1 linux/arm64, Landlock ABI 4): all 99 declared packages identical per-test outcomes confined vs unconfined, 5179 outcomes, 33 skips; declaration and replay unchanged. Fix CEM .corvint/changes/684cce0f64c6fe63c5a69dde0b715f9e50eeccce.cem.json (10/10 supported, check PASS, sealed); PR438 head 5e7dfab15bde1f48b501e5a35b45db9ca9b164ed. Hosted rerun and admin ci-control-plane approval still pending; keep open.
title: gate: bound the 129 unresolved test packages (cmd/corvint first) so a tree change stops rerunning all of them
